name: inspira-flip-words
blurb: Words flip vertically and rotate through a cycling list.
description: Renders a placeholder text that cycles through an array of words, each flipping in 3D on a per-word duration. Non-interactive.
use_when: Dynamic section headers or taglines that showcase multiple benefits or features in rotation.
avoid_when: Long-form or dense content — rapid word swaps make scanning difficult.
a11y: Renders only the current word; screen readers may miss the rotation. No pause control.
